verdict.rationale: OpenCode's permission system lets leads set actions to auto-run, prompt, or block per tool/input, and MCP servers (external tools) are explicitly added/configured (docs-4/23/41). Enterprise config also lets orgs force use of an internal AI gateway and SSO, further restricting what integrations agents can reach (docs-33/50). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that permission rules reliably block disallowed MCP tool calls in practice, and finer detail on allow/deny lists for specific external tool names beyond the general permission object.
